title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Lowering the Donation Disclosure Threshold) Bill 2023
short_title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Lowering the Donation Disclosure Threshold) Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would lower the threshold for reporting political donations from $16,300 to $1,000 per year and stop automatic adjustments for inflation.
Political parties would have to provide the Australian Electoral Commission with annual returns detailing donations over the new $1,000 threshold.
The bill would also expand the definition of a gift to include electoral spending, gifts-in-kind worth $1,000 or more, and payments to attend fundraisers.
changes: Lowers the donation disclosure threshold from $16,300 to $1,000 per year.
Removes ongoing indexation of the disclosure threshold.
Expands the definition of a gift to include electoral expenditure, gifts-in-kind, and fundraiser attendance payments.
summary.affected: Political parties and donors who give to political entities.
